resources.string: This is an app widget description

Welcome to nHome! 
		Transform your home screen with a widget that does it all. nHome is a launcher and utility hub that brings you:
• Music : Search for the Music you like and play uninterrupted, with smooth cross-fading. 
• Dynamic Wallpapers : Search Nature / Music / Abstract / your favorite type and set auto-change timers (15/30/60 mins).
• Essential Tools : Real-time weather, location details, and reminders at a glance.
• One-Click Ease : Instantly change wallpapers or use the lock screen shortcut.
• Connected Life : Stay updated with favorite tweets and chat with Gemini AI.
• Monitor Wifi and Bluetooth statuses efficiently without draining much Battery(i mean get full screen popups to turn off Wifi/Bluetooth when not connected and simply just draining the Battery).
• And a lot more, enJoy the Ride!


 MAKE SURE TO CLICK ON YELLOW TRIANGLES ( ⚠️ - IN THE WIDGET ON STARTUP) AND GRANT PERMISSIONS TO SEE THEM IN ACTION!
